<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h1 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Code review for data in dbt</h1><a id="user-content-code-review-for-data-in-dbt" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Code review for data in dbt" href="#code-review-for-data-in-dbt"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">PipeRider automatically compares your data to highlight the difference in impacted downstream dbt models so you can
merge your Pull Requests with confidence.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">How it works:</h3><a id="user-content-how-it-works" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: How it works:" href="#how-it-works"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Easy to connect your datasource -> PipeRider leverages
the <a href="https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/get-started/connection-profiles" rel="nofollow">connection profiles in your dbt project</a> to connect
to the data warehouse</li>
<li>Generate profiling statistics of your models to get a high-level overview of your data</li>
<li>Compare target branch changes with the main branch in a HTML report</li>
<li>Post a quick summary of the data changes to your PR, so others can be confident too</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Core concepts</h3><a id="user-content-core-concepts" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Core concepts" href="#core-concepts"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Easy to install</strong>: Leveraging dbt's configuration settings, PipeRider can be installed within 2 minutes</li>
<li><strong>Fast comparison</strong>: by collecting profiling statistics (e.g. uniqueness, averages, quantiles, histogram) and metric
queries, comparing downstream data impact takes little time, speeding up your team's review time</li>
<li><strong>Valuable insights</strong>: various profiling statistics displayed in the HTML report give fast insights into your data</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h1 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Quickstart</h1><a id="user-content-quickstart" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Quickstart" href="#quickstart"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Install PipeRider</strong></p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="pip install piperider[<connector>]"><pre>pip install piperider[<span class="pl-k"><</span>connector<span class="pl-k">></span>]</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">You can find all supported data source connectors <a href="https://docs.piperider.io/reference/supported-data-sources" rel="nofollow">here</a>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Add PipeRider tag on your model</strong>: Go to your dbt project, and add the PipeRider tag on the model you want to
profile.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-sql notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="--models/staging/stg_customers.sql
{{ config(
   tags=["piperider"]
) }}

select ..."><pre><span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">--</span>models/staging/stg_customers.sql</span>
{{ config(
   tags<span class="pl-k">=</span>[<span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>piperider<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>]
) }}

<span class="pl-k">select</span> ...</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">and show the models would be run by piperider</p>
<div class="snippet-clipboard-content notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=" dbt list -s tag:piperider --resource-type model"><pre class="notranslate"><code> dbt list -s tag:piperider --resource-type model
</code></pre></div>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Run PipeRider</strong></p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="piperider run"><pre>piperider run</pre></div>
</li>
</ol>
<p dir="auto">To see the full quick start guide, please refer
to <a href="https://docs.piperider.io/get-started/quick-start" rel="nofollow">PipeRider documentation</a></p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h1 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Features</h1><a id="user-content-features" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Features" href="#features"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Model profiling</strong>: PipeRider can profile your <a href="https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/build/models" rel="nofollow">dbt models</a> and obtain
information such as basic data composition, quantiles, histograms, text length, top categories, and more.</li>
<li><strong>Metric queries</strong>: PipeRider can integrate with <a href="https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/build/metrics" rel="nofollow">dbt metrics</a> and present
the time-series data of metrics in the report.</li>
<li><strong>HTML report</strong>: PipeRider generates a static HTML report each time it runs, which can be viewed locally or shared.</li>
<li><strong>Report comparison</strong>: You can compare two previously generated reports or use a single command to compare the
differences between the current branch and the main branch. The latter is designed specifically for code review
scenarios. In our pull requests on GitHub, we not only want to know which files have been changed, but also the impact
of these changes on the data. PipeRider can easily generate comparison reports with a single command to provide this
information.</li>
<li><strong>CI integration</strong>: The key to CI is automation, and in the code review process, automating this workflow is even more
meaningful. PipeRider can easily integrate into your CI process. When new commits are pushed to your PR branch,
reports can be automatically generated to provide reviewers with more confidence in the changes made when reviewing.</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h1 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Example Report Demo</h1><a id="user-content-example-report-demo" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Example Report Demo" href="#example-report-demo"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>

use piperider+dbt+duckdb to analyze <a href="https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core">dbt-core</a> repository. Here is the generated
result (daily update)</p>
<p dir="auto"><a href="https://piperider-github-readme.s3.ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com/single-run-report/index.html" rel="nofollow">Run Report</a></p>
